analyst_view.overall: Early view: Game 3 at PayPal Park on Wednesday 2 December, only played if the series is 1-1, with kick-off still to be set; a draw goes to penalties. Houston would fly back to California four days after hosting Game 2. The two league meetings ended 0-0 and 1-0, and both clubs' seasons point to tight games.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.8 goals. I lean lower: these teams produced one goal in two league meetings, Houston's defence and Bond's 12 clean sheets are their strength, and a decider between two careful sides rarely opens up early.

corners.text: The site expects 10.5 corners with most for San Jose. In a decider San Jose at home should have more of the ball and the corners that come with it, which matches the site's split; I have nothing to move the total.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.3 cards. I lean a little higher for a third meeting in eight days with a semifinal place on the line; San Jose were booked three times in their last league game.

shots.text: The site expects 26.9 shots. Werner's fitness and the short turnaround weigh on San Jose, and Houston are a low-event team, so I lean lower.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.4 on target. Both teams have struggled to hit the target lately (Houston six of 23 against St. Louis, San Jose three at Minnesota), so I lean lower.
